decisions.primaryObject: Transactional cancellation of unsettled agent runs when a conversation is deleted
decisions.reason: The mechanism explicitly governs queued, approval-waiting and running work under the same lock used for admission, making deletion, cancellation and orphan prevention a bounded Digital Employee lifecycle question.
decisions.nextAction: Skill 03 may inspect only cancellation transaction semantics, covered run states, the admission-lock relationship, orphan prevention and explicit limitations.

decisions.primaryObject: Short-lived workload identity exchange with child-process credential boundary
decisions.reason: One concrete implementation exposes an enterprise identity control plane: workload JWT exchange, short-lived credential caching and refresh, plus explicit stripping of launch-context identity from executions, MCP servers, hooks, Git and remote child processes.
decisions.nextAction: Skill 03 may inspect only identity exchange, refresh/coalescing, credential lifetime, child-process stripping and trust-boundary behavior.

decisions.primaryObject: Checkpoint conformance as a detector for persisted-state migration defects
decisions.reason: The change is directly implementable and testable: enabling one shared checkpoint conformance suite across SQLite and Postgres immediately exposed a persisted delta-history migration defect that had previously been skipped.
decisions.nextAction: Skill 03 may inspect only the conformance contract, migrated plain-value seed detection, backend parity, failure reproduction and remaining persistence boundaries.
